graph_nodes.func: post-9b (step 11 through `_folder_holds_project`; the inside-W data / A2L arms after the lstat walk). Relative text: `resolve_input_path` → `None` → `not found`; folder → `not a supported file`; by suffix. Absolute: `resolve_input_path`; the lexical inside test; outside by suffix; inside: lstat walk (`not found`, `unreadable`, `link`), one component, the `list_projects()` + `normcase` match (`not a project`), then the content test. "Never raises" is claimed for `OSError` only: `resolve_input_path` on a relative text holding NUL raises `ValueError`. 12a changes: a `ValueError` from either `resolve_input_path` call → `("refuse", "not found")` (LLR-172.5i); the match moves into `_listed_project_name` (LLR-172.5j).
